premise.dramatic_question: Will {HEROES} restart {MECHANISM} before the flood tide, finishing the restart routine {MAKER} left for whoever {KEEPER} judges ready?
resolution_space: the flood ledgers teach them how past overflows were handled, arming a smarter attempt tomorrow
a loose page from the ledgers, copied out, goes home with them to puzzle over before the next tide
the evening tide horns cut the reading short, and the warden walks them out with a promise to leave the ledgers open
a level look at the catwalk convinces them that crossing it tonight would cost more than it proves
one friend says the crossing isn't worth it and the others agree without argument, calling the retreat a sound call
a foot slips on the wet rail and the near-miss turns the attempt into a calm, deliberate retreat
yanking levers at random trips a safeguard built for exactly that shortcut, freezing the board until the warden resets it
the tide horns sound before any lever lands right, and the restart must wait for the morning crew
the overworked gearing raises a grinding fuss that brings the warden up to end the attempt for the night
the stalled gearing binds fast, and nothing they carry tonight will free it
a bent linkage needs a tool the restart routine clearly expects, and nobody brought one
the warden's posted rule ends forcing attempts at nightfall, and they honor it as part of doing the job right
the workshop adopts them as its quiet keepers, the thanks for a job nobody told them they were doing
some unfinished repair in the room invites their hands, and finishing it becomes their standing task
Maren Pool's own notes name whoever finds the room its caretaker, and the friends accept the charge
the restart is announced and celebrated by the settlement, the tide-engine's return made public at last
the restart quietly saves something the settlement was about to lose, proof enough without an announcement
the restart earns the warden's open trust and a standing invitation back to the lock-house
a promise sworn over the keepsake binds the friends as the ones who quietly kept the engine running
they reset every gauge exactly as found, keeping the fix and leaving the rest untouched
Maren Pool's letter asks its finders to choose, and they choose to let the fix stay quiet
the engine's true safeguard announces the grab, and the warden arrives before the door does
what they try to carry out is exactly what the safeguard was built to catch on the way down
second thoughts slow them just enough for the warden's evening rounds to catch them mid-return, the last gauge answered honestly after all

label_styles: terse imperatives, three words where possible
first-person plural resolves: what we do next
question-forms at decisions, statements at continues
name the place or thing, let the action stay implied

facts.doors_barred: the lock-house's outer doors stand barred by storm wrack, and the warden's appeal reads as urgent rather than ceremonial
facts.appeal_posted: the warden's hand-lettered appeal for capable hands is nailed where anyone passing will see it
facts.crew_ready: the friends read the appeal together and commit to answering it as one crew
facts.task_accepted: the friends have agreed to take on the warden's restart routine before the tide turns
facts.caution_proven: working the flag-code checklist line by line proves caution is worth the minutes it costs
facts.route_named_by_checklist: the checklist's proven line names a specific service route into the flooded lower works
facts.grit_shown: hauling storm debris clear of two overlooked ways in, a low grate and a high sluice gate, by their own effort proves the friends' grit
facts.warden_tested_them: the warden has watched how the friends handle the appeal and reads it as fair testing, not idle suspicion
facts.warden_offer_earned: the warden, satisfied, offers both a way past the barred door and what he remembers of the engine's builder
facts.makers_purpose_understood: Engineer Maren Pool built the tide-engine's fail-safes decades ago out of care for a town she would not always be there to protect
facts.past_the_barred_door: the friends stand past the lock-house's barred outer door, however they earned the way through
facts.service_points_known: four service points are known: the winch loft, the map room, the weir catwalk, and the engine racks below
facts.checklist_read: the friends carry a working grasp of the flag code's restart logic, earned at some service point
facts.ledgers_beckon: the map room's toll ledgers pose their own quiet pull: linger over them, or press on to the tide board
facts.catwalk_dares_them: the weir catwalk is the most direct test of nerve among the four service points
facts.cache_glimpsed: something Maren Pool set aside for whoever crosses the catwalk safely waits at its far end
facts.at_the_tide_board: the friends stand at the great tide board, the engine's last control point
facts.board_reading_live: the tide board's own gauge states plainly what setting will restart the engine, and that forcing it has a cost
facts.engine_restarted: the friends restart the tide-engine on the warden's own terms
facts.engine_jammed: forcing the tide board's levers stalls the engine's gearing instead of restarting it
facts.second_gauge_found: a second, smaller gauge is found behind the tide board
facts.strongroom_entered: the friends stand inside the flood-safe strongroom the engine was built to protect
facts.strongroom_seen: what the engine protects is seen: Maren Pool's letter and modest things meant for the whole town
facts.steady_exit: the friends leave with their composure intact; the outcome is a result, never a shaming
facts.routine_reopens: the tide-engine's restart routine can be attempted again; nothing about tonight uses it up
facts.ledger_set_straight: whatever was disturbed is put back and owned honestly to the warden
facts.hidden_workshop_found: Maren Pool's living workshop is found past the second gauge
facts.care_role_earned: the friends earn ongoing responsibility for what they found
facts.restart_made_public: the friends' successful restart is shared with the settlement
facts.restart_kept_private: the friends' successful restart stays a private matter among them
facts.crew_bond_formed: the shared repair forges a lasting trust between the friends
facts.warden_intervenes: the warden turns up in the moment of temptation, mid-task whether the friends know it or not

safety_envelope.affect_ceiling: suspense with wonder and mild urgency; tension may tighten but never tips into threat

cipher_forms.note: one cipher form per story, chosen at bind and used consistently from note to clockface to back panel

access_details.note: one concrete way in per approach branch: the note's decoded route and the building's own weak point draw freely; the keeper's branch stays person-mediated

cipher_hint_carriers.note: one per exploration room, drawn freely; unique_within_story gives each book four different carriers, and each carries enough logic that any single room makes the dial attemptable

room_curiosities.note: what makes each room distinct and worth the visit beyond its hint

vault_contents.note: the vault protects knowledge, heritage, and wonder; any treasure is modest and communal, never loot

obstacle_kinds.note: physical difficulty stays honest and non-injurious; failure costs time or access, never safety

safeguards.note: the maker's anti-taking measure; gentle and funny, it embarrasses no one and hurts no one

remedies.note: the honest way back from a jam, on the machine's own terms; care, patience, or wit, never strength

loft_signatures.note: the one detail that makes the maker's hidden room feel currently alive rather than preserved

affect.target: wary readiness, the pull of being needed

cipher_form.note: the story's one flag-code form; every later restart step renders it consistently

choice_semantics.c_open: answer the appeal aloud, committing themselves before the tide turns

n_open.beat_hint: A silent flood bell and a barred door mean somebody has to get inside before dark, and the friends decide that somebody is them.

affect.target: brisk resolve, sizing up which job buys the most time

constraints.offers_must_be: three genuinely different first jobs: read the gauges, clear a way in, or find the warden; no option is the smart one
constraints.must_not: resolve any task here; the split happens before anyone finishes a job

choice_semantics.c_examine: start with the numbers: read the posted flood gauge before doing anything else
choice_semantics.c_door: start with muscle: clear the storm debris from the low hatch yourselves
choice_semantics.c_keeper: start with people: go find the warden and offer your hands

n_start.beat_hint: Three jobs need doing before the water rises, and the friends split on which one to tackle first.

affect.target: the click of numbers finally lining up

access_route.note: the checklist's proven line names one concrete way in: where it hides or how it works, plus a plain first step

constraints.reading_must_be: shown on the page in the story's one flag-code form, so a reader can play along; first entry only
constraints.must_not: make the reading trivial or make the other two jobs look like the wrong call for not trying it first

choice_semantics.c_note_key: follow the gauge mark to wherever the checklist says the spare crank is cached
choice_semantics.c_note_inside: grab a lantern and head straight for the hatch the checklist names

n_note.beat_hint: Numbers on a gauge do not argue, and once they line up, the friends have two honest ways to spend what they learned.

affect.target: stubborn satisfaction in muscling a problem loose

access_route.note: the building's own overlooked way in; clearing it reads as grit, never as damage

constraints.entry_must_read: as capable, hands-on work on a storm-battered building, not as break-in
constraints.must_not: carry any checklist knowledge; this branch never stopped to read the gauge

choice_semantics.c_door_force: pry the swollen low door with a scavenged lever, keeping it once it's done its job
choice_semantics.c_door_window: climb up to release the jammed high sluice gate instead

n_door.beat_hint: A jammed door and a stuck gate do not care how clever the friends are, only how hard they are willing to work.

affect.target: the nerves of being looked over, then the relief of being trusted

access_route.note: kept person-mediated on purpose: this branch's whole meaning is earning a person's trust, not finding a trick

constraints.warden_must_be: gruff on the surface, glad underneath that someone finally showed up; an adult who takes kids seriously
constraints.must_not: have the warden do the restart for them or forbid the attempt

choice_semantics.c_keeper_enter: follow the warden's lantern down to the works right away
choice_semantics.c_keeper_story: offer to carry his tool bag while he explains who built the engine

n_keeper.beat_hint: The warden says nothing about a test, but carrying his tools without being asked earns more than a lantern would.

affect.target: satisfaction of a plan that checks out in the real world

constraints.payoff_must_be: the crank exactly where the gauge marks promised; the world confirms the reading was right
constraints.must_not: introduce a second puzzle here; this beat is confirmation, not complication

choice_semantics.c_keyhunt_in: wind the hatch ratchet open with the recovered crank

n_keyhunt.beat_hint: Finding the crank exactly where the numbers said proves the reading was sound, not lucky.

affect.target: hushed listening, a stranger's care becoming personal

constraints.history_must_be: warm and specific: Maren Pool built the fail-safes out of care for the town, not out of secrecy; motive stays kind while details stay open
constraints.must_not: reveal what the strongroom holds or how the tide board's reading resolves

choice_semantics.c_story_in: hurry down before the tide catches up with the story still fresh

n_keeper_story.beat_hint: Once he starts talking, the friends finally understand why a laid-up old man would ask a bunch of kids for help.

affect.target: quick nerve, then the hush of having made it through

constraints.climb_must_be: exciting but visibly safe: short drop, good holds, friends spotting each other
constraints.must_not: injure anyone or play the climb as recklessness

choice_semantics.c_window_in: climb in through the sluice gate they just freed

n_window.beat_hint: The gate they forced open a minute ago is now just a doorway, and climbing through settles nothing except that they're inside.

affect.target: brisk focus: the real work starts now

n_inside.merge_note: NC-1: six parents (n_note, n_door, n_keeper, n_keyhunt, n_keeper_story, n_window) arrive by different routes carrying different proofs. Presuppose only the intersection: the appeal exists, the friends accepted the job and are together. Do NOT reference how they got in, which job they led with, or whether the warden is present. Write arrival generically: they are past the barred door, the real work starts now.

constraints.offers_must_be: four sensory, distinct service points matching the four rooms: height, paper, motion, depth; each stands alone
constraints.must_not: rank the service points or hint one is the correct one

choice_semantics.c_inside_stairs: climb to the winch loft: wind the spring there
choice_semantics.c_inside_study: duck into the map room: recalibrate the survey instrument
choice_semantics.c_inside_pendulum: edge along the weir catwalk: retrieve the cached gauge
choice_semantics.c_inside_basement: go down to the engine racks: log the rack readings

n_inside.beat_hint: Past the barred door, four separate jobs still need doing before the board can be read at all.

affect.target: the burn of cranking a stiff spring turning into quiet pride

hint_carrier.note: something met in the loft that teaches a usable piece of the tide board's reading

curiosity.note: a small token of Maren Pool's found in the loft; personal, pocketable, easily missed

constraints.hint_must_be: sufficient on its own to make the tide board's reading attemptable for someone who never read the checklist
constraints.must_not: presuppose the checklist reading is already done

choice_semantics.c_stairs_face: carry the wound spring gauge down to the tide board

n_stairs.beat_hint: Winding the loft spring back to tension is its own small job, and finishing it earns a working gauge.

affect.target: the pull of a job that rewards lingering as much as leaving

hint_carrier.note: whatever in Maren Pool's own map room teaches the reading most directly; the richest hint of the four

curiosity.note: the ledgers whose pull is genuine: something browsable enough to fill an evening; staying is a legitimate answer

constraints.temptation_must_be: honest: the ledgers really are fascinating, and choosing them is a legitimate reader identity, not a failure
constraints.must_not: frame staying to read as laziness or failure

choice_semantics.c_study_face: take the recalibrated gauge and press on to the tide board
choice_semantics.c_study_logs: let the ledgers win: choose the record over the clock

n_study.beat_hint: There is no rule against getting absorbed in old flood records instead of finishing the job faster.

affect.target: focused nerve: this job asks the most of the four

hint_carrier.note: something about the moving gearing, legible from a safe spot, that teaches a piece of the tide board's reading

obstacle.note: a traversal with real, legible, survivable risk; the far side holds something worth the daring

constraints.peril_must_be: mild and legible: the worst case is a soaked boot and a long walk back; the crossing rewards care, not daring
constraints.must_not: punish the reader for either crossing or declining; both are respectable answers

choice_semantics.c_pendulum_oil: cross with care and unhook Maren Pool's cached gauge
choice_semantics.c_pendulum_giveup: judge the crossing honestly and turn back

n_pendulum.beat_hint: Wet rails and a long drop make this the hardest of the four jobs, though the spare gauge at the end is worth arguing for.

affect.target: dim-lit calm, steady hands rewarded in the dark

hint_carrier.note: something down among the engine's roots that teaches a piece of the tide board's reading from below

curiosity.note: what makes the deepest room worth the dark; the straight way up is the room's parting gift

constraints.darkness_must_be: atmosphere, not threat; the racks are dim and strange, never menacing
constraints.must_not: presuppose the checklist reading is already done

choice_semantics.c_basement_face: log the rack readings before heading straight up

n_basement.beat_hint: Down among the racks, the job is steady hands and careful notes, not cleverness.

affect.target: peak focus; every service point narrows to this one board

n_clockface.merge_note: NC-1: four parents (n_stairs, n_study, n_pendulum, n_basement), each of which supplied checklist_read from a DIFFERENT service point. Presuppose checklist_read generically: the friends have a working grasp of the board's reading, source unnamed. Do NOT presuppose which service point was visited, any object carried from any room, or any specific room. The board itself must restate its reading: its own gauge echoes the flag-code form, so the correct-setting choice is honest on every path.

constraints.puzzle_must_be: self-teaching at the board: the gauge rhymes with the reading the reader carries, so restarting feels earned, not lucky
constraints.stakes_must_be: clear before choosing: setting, forcing, searching, and guessing are visibly different bets
constraints.must_not: reference any carried object or any room's device; the board's own gauge and levers carry the whole beat

choice_semantics.c_face_correct: set the levers on the board's own terms, deliberately
choice_semantics.c_face_jam: muscle the big lever instead of reading the gauge
choice_semantics.c_face_panel: distrust the gauge, go looking for a maintenance panel
choice_semantics.c_face_random: yank levers at random and hope it catches

n_clockface.beat_hint: Every route through the lock-house ends here, at a board that will not turn without an honest reading.

affect.target: a held breath let go as the gearing finally turns over

constraints.solution_must_be: shown, not skipped: the setting follows the reading the reader carries, in the story's one flag-code form
constraints.must_not: presuppose the note branch or any specific room; the reasoning works from the generic hint plus the board's own gauge

choice_semantics.c_correct_vault: step through into the strongroom the restart unlocked

n_setcorrect.beat_hint: The gearing catches on the first honest try, and the door behind the board finally gives.

affect.target: a wince at forcing it, then resolve to do it properly

remedy.note: the engine's own honest way back from the stall, supplied entirely by the bible

constraints.remedy_must_be: workable at the scene on every path, presupposing nothing carried from any other room
constraints.jam_must_read: as the engine protecting itself, a fair consequence of forcing, not a punishment of the friends

choice_semantics.c_jam_oil: work the problem: free the stalled gearing and try the reading properly

n_setjam.beat_hint: The big lever does not bend to muscle, and pretending otherwise only means doing the job twice.

affect.target: sly delight at finding a gauge nobody mentioned

constraints.panel_reading_must_be: the same flag-code form as the checklist, smaller and quicker; reading it uses the carried hint, never the full checklist
constraints.must_not: make this route feel like cheating; Maren Pool built it on purpose for careful searchers

choice_semantics.c_panel_vault: read the second gauge toward the strongroom
choice_semantics.c_panel_secret: follow the second gauge the other way, toward a room no one mentioned

n_backpanel.beat_hint: Nobody has to open the panel behind the board, which is exactly why the ones who do find something extra.

affect.target: quiet awe; the engine is running again, and now a question about what to do with that

n_vault.merge_note: NC-1: three parents (n_setcorrect, n_setjam, n_backpanel) opened the way by different means. Presuppose only that they stand past the board with the restart in hand; write the strongroom's opening as already behind them without re-describing which route yielded it.

contents.note: Maren Pool's letter, the keepsake, and a modest heritage treasure; the letter's voice is kind and asks nothing

constraints.choice_must_be: a genuine three-way question of character with no narrator's thumb on the scale before the outcome

choice_semantics.c_vault_share: let the restart be public: carry the letter to the settlement
choice_semantics.c_vault_keep: let the restart stay private: swear the crew to keep it between them
choice_semantics.c_vault_grab: treat the strongroom as a prize to loot instead of a job well done

n_vault.beat_hint: A running engine still leaves one open question: who gets to know about it, and who gets to stay quiet.
